text.p: Willamette Industries Tuesday said it set a two-for-one stock split of its common stock.
The forests products company said the split will be implemented as a stock dividend, payable on September 12 for stockholders of record August 25.
The company also declared a regular cash dividend of $0.32 for each pre-split share, payable on September 12 to stockholders of record August 25.

Willamette said the $0.32 quarterly dividend translates into a $0.16 a share quarterly dividend rate after it effects the stock split, but added the future dividends' timing and amounts remain at the discretion of its board of directors.

The company also said its board approved plans to build a new engineered wood products complex near Simsboro, La.; to upgrade a paper machine at its Johnsonburg, Pa., paper mill; and install environmental projects at its plant near Bennettsville, S.C.
The company's stock hit a new 52-week high of 78-3/4 Tuesday, and was trading at 78-5/16 in the early afternoon.
